declaration_deltas.why_unmapped: Two optional hints on the permission-ask dialog record above toolUseID (0.3.270 sdk.d.ts:242-258): decline-by-default rendering and no persistent always-allow choice. The CanUseTool callback signature (toolName, input, options) and the PermissionResult union are byte-identical, and the sidecar answers canUseTool programmatically without rendering the dialog, so neither flag can reach admission.

Prose now notes both fields are always present (possibly empty) on success initialize from Claude Code 2.1.268+ and that an inherited prompt can stay answerable without appearing. The sidecar reads neither field; no new parsed surface.

New 'argv' (default) | 'initialize' selector for how plugins reach the native process. Unset keeps the argv path exactly, and the route passes plugins: [] with the selector unset, so zero --plugin-dir flags flow either way. The shipped implementation defaults the selector to 'argv' when unset.

Omitted-or-true is now the recording default; the route passes a constant digest-pinned systemPrompt only for selected-skill bundles and never varies the text mid-session, so the first-request render and every later record carry the identical prompt. No sidecar change needed.
Comment rewrites on a Query method the route never calls; set_settings and effort selection flow nowhere near it.
Optional skip flag on the unstable usage API the route never calls.
Optional hold flag and two response fields on the plugin-reload control the route never sends.
New control to re-read output-style directories; the route never calls it and no new claim names it.
Present-only first-byte-timeout timings on the retry record. The sidecar assistant projection reads content parts only; message-level retry metadata is ignored.
Stamp-rule prose for typed vs synthetic turns; the route reads neither field, and unknown record fields stay ignored while unknown record and part types still fail closed, as frozen for 0.3.259.
Worker-restart re-run marker stamped beside user_message_uuid on assistant, partial, and result frames. Message-level and ignored by the projection, which never branches on turn lineage.
Wrapper-level sibling for max-output-tokens recovery replays. Ignored by the projection like every other wrapper-level marker.
'used'|'free'|'buffer'|'deferred' classifier on getContextUsage rows; the route never calls getContextUsage.
New /hooks-menu listing control; the route sends no control requests and reads no hook listing.
Request-side twin of the usage skip flag; same uncalled API.
Absent-vs-empty clarification on per-model weekly windows; the route never calls the usage API.

One-shot cache of in-process servers' own handshake output, consumed by the connect that follows initialize and never retained. The sidecar never sends it, so the CLI lists over the control channel exactly as before.

Stdin form of --plugin-dir entries, loaded only by a CLI launched with --await-initialize. The sidecar launches without that flag and passes plugins: [], so the field loads nothing; plugins_applied is absent exactly as before.
Additive response fields. The sidecar reads its admitted initialize subset; additive fields are ignored.

First-command prewait latch prose on the mapped interrupt() method. The declaration signature is unchanged, the sidecar calls interrupt() and reads only receipt presence behind the interrupt_receipt_v1 capability gate, and it never parses still_queued — so the native-side latch cannot alter the route's mapped cancel contract.

New live-permission-rules listing control with SDKPermissionRuleEntry/Description/WorkspaceDirectory rows. The route sends no control requests; permission state still flows only through canUseTool admission.
Staged-lane note on the mcp_call control the route never sends.
Request/response twins of the reloadOutputStyles control; uncalled.
Request-side twin of the reload hold flag; uncalled.
Rename attribution fields on a control the route never sends.
Union gains get_hooks_listing, list_permission_rules, and reload_output_styles. Additive members on the control channel the sidecar never writes to.
Per-frame attribution on thinking progress frames; the projection carries no thinking content.
File-tool calibration note on the advisory denial event; the denial path (canUseTool deny short-circuit vs terminal ask) is unchanged.

'service'|'channel'|'group_pool' scope on the spend-limit record. The result projection reads subtype, is_error, counts, timings, api_error_status, and terminal_reason only; spend records stay ignored.

Re-run reason, delivery sequence, and first-content/post/ack timing fields on result records. The projection ignores every message-level field outside its validated set, and resultFieldPresence stays an open bounded map, so new keys cannot fail decoding.
Optional betas array beside the mapped apiKeySource/cwd/model/capabilities system fields. Ignored by readiness, which still gates on apiProvider firstParty.
'not activity' rewording on task rows; the activity projection keys on skip_transcript and watcher shape, not the comment.
Bash/task output tuning in the managed-settings tier; the route passes settingSources: [] so no settings layer loads at all.
Managed plugin ordering and marketplace keys; same suppression — no settings source is ever loaded.
Admin-tier gateway and settings-composition keys; same suppression.
Restrictive-boolean strictest-wins clarification; same suppression.
Effort clamp keys; same suppression. Effort still flows only through the mapped Options.effort input.
No-effect marker on a terminal prompt key that never reaches the route.

Optional delivery-cursor hook for transports with a consumer-facing cursor. The sidecar provides only the spawnClaudeCodeProcess hook and implements no Transport, so the addition has no implementor to affect.

project_memory_list/read methods and ProjectsInput members, artifact list_types/icon/staged/cowritten/foreign/seq/unchanged/written fields, and skill-description prose. Skills and tool I/O shapes are prohibited on this route; every occurrence sits in the unmapped skill/tool tier.
fromSequenceNum/getSseLastSequenceNum/getCcrEvent resume-cursor surface on the /browser subpath. The route never imports /browser and the sidecar falsifier stays clean.

Two new assistant error strings. The sidecar assistant projection never reads message.error — it projects content parts only — and the Rust wire decodes sidecar-projected events, never the raw union, so no new string can reach failure classification.
